description: utopia-php/di: a PSR-11 container of factories with declared dependencies, built once, resolved through parent containers.

di.set.doc: $container->set(id, factory, dependencies?) === $container, where factory is {kind: value, value}, {kind: counter} (returns how many times it ran), {kind: format, template} ({i} replaced by the i-th dependency), {kind: list} (the dependencies), {kind: sum} (their sum) or {kind: fail, message} (throws ContainerException)

di.script.doc: replays calls on four containers (0 root, 1 child of 0, 2 child of 1, 3 child of 0): {op: set|get|has|scope, container, id, dependencies?}. Ids are a..e; a set's dependencies are offsets after its id in that order (`missing` past e), so they never form a cycle, and its factory returns `id#runs(dependencies)`. Returns each call's result ({"$error"} for a failure)

deviations.php: The walk up the chain stops at the first parent that is another PSR-11 container (ContainerTest::testScopeCannotCopyAFactoryFromAnotherPsrContainer): scoping an id only that container has throws NotFoundException.
deviations.reason: A utopia_di::Container's parent is always a Container (with_parent takes Arc<Container>), so a foreign PSR-11 parent is unrepresentable; every other scope behaviour is covered.
